chats.answer:
The best laptop screen extender depends on whether you want a single extra screen, a dual-screen setup, or something lightweight for travel.

For most people, I'd prioritize display quality, stability, portability, and USB-C compatibility over simply choosing the cheapest extender.

There are two main designs:

Laptop-mounted extender

Attaches directly to your laptop. Best for working in hotels, coffee shops, and tight spaces.

Standalone portable monitor

Sits beside your laptop. Usually lighter, more flexible, and easier to position ergonomically.
